hypothesis: Replacing low-information v14a4 chosen-answer prose with researcher-curated causal explanations improves semantic adequacy without losing v14a10 EOS gains.
only_intervention: Replace each of the same 28 chosen-answer strings. No prompt, route, family, selected ID, batch order, parent weights, model, optimizer, learning-rate schedule, or EOS token ID changes.

arms.name: original_eos_control
arms.targets: original v14a10 authored chosen answers with exactly one EOS id=3

arms.name: corrected_eos
arms.targets: 28 checked researcher-authored causal explanations with exactly one EOS id=3

invariant_controls.canonical_parent: SHA256-verified canonical v14a2; independent strict reload per arm
invariant_controls.tokenizer: tokenizer-v9 52224 vocabulary; EOS id=3; EOT id=7
invariant_controls.sampling: v14a6 TargetPulseSampler(seed=928+801) exact same row IDs and order
invariant_controls.control_replay_reference: v14a10 explicit_eos arm at u40, independently stored on S3

measured_not_controlled.answer_length: Correcting prose changes target token length and the per-token cross-entropy mixture; record all lengths and tokens.
measured_not_controlled.reference_termination: P(EOS/EOT) after reference answer under teacher forcing, not natural stop frequency
measured_not_controlled.fixed_holdout: The 32-case holdout was already analyzed in v14a11; treat it as a development diagnostic, not newly blinded evaluation.

early_abort: Abort corrected arm if replayed historical v14a10 explicit-EOS control violates preregistered reproduction tolerances.

semantic_criterion.strict_minimum: Answer must explain the requested mechanism correctly; naming a concept or repeating a generic answer-style phrase does not suffice.
semantic_criterion.intended_effect: At least six more of 32 strictly adequate answers relative to concurrently reproduced control, with improvement in norm_threshold, learning_rate_comparison and false_premise_correction.
